title: SDK Quickstart Storyboard & Screenshot Set — auth, keys, streaming, tool-calls
creator: Ava Martínez
body: Create a cohesive set of onboarding visuals for the SDK/API quickstart docs that cover: 1) authentication and API key creation flows (web console + CLI snippet), 2) streaming text setup and an example stream UI overlay, and 3) basic tool-calling flow (registering tools, an example tool response). Deliverables should include a storyboard (mobile + desktop variants), annotated screenshots ready for docs, a small set of in-doc GIFs for streaming, and polished export-ready PNG/SVG assets. Work includes exploratory sketches, Figma comps, accessibility pass (alt copy + color contrast), developer handoff notes, and a docs PR checklist for integration. Align microcopy with Console UX and SDK error messaging. This ticket covers everything up to handoff and the initial docs PR; separate follow-ups will track CI integration and i18n tweaks.
acceptance_criteria: Storyboard frames for auth, keys, streaming, and tool-calls produced in Figma (desktop and mobile variants)
At least 6 annotated screenshots exported: 3 x desktop, 3 x mobile — filenames use docs convention: onboarding_<topic>_<variant>.png
Streaming sequence exported as 2 lightweight GIFs and 1 looping MP4 for product pages
Assets sized and exported per docs spec: 1600x900 PNG; 800x450 PNG mobile; SVG icons with named layers
Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM and Docs (Priya Kapoor), UX copy matches Console wording
Handoff bundle (Figma link, export ZIP, layer naming, alt text) posted and linked in the docs PR (#1234)
No blocking accessibility issues (contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text; alt text provided)
tasks: Kickoff sketch session with PM & SDK engineer — capture edge cases for key rotation and streaming timeouts
Draft storyboard (6-8 panels) showing end-to-end quickstart flows
Produce high-fidelity screenshots and UI overlays in Figma
Create streaming GIFs with synthetic latency to demonstrate progressive output
Annotate screenshots with callouts for copy, token masking, and error states
Prepare export pack and upload to Drive; add links to docs PR
Review with Docs + PM; incorporate feedback; finalize handoff
handoff_notes: Layer naming: use docs-friendly prefixes: DOC_<topic>_<variant>_v1
Token/Key masking: always blur keys in screenshots; use placeholder <REDACTED_KEY> in code blocks
Alt text: include brief functional description + any important state (e.g., 'Streaming output: partial tokens visible')
GIFs: capped at 3MB, 30 FPS max, include 2-3 frames per logical step
Dev snippets: include copy/paste JS and Python examples; link to GitHub snippet Gist #sdk-quickstart-2026
Color tokens: provide both HEX and token names for Console theme variables (e.g., --redwood-primary)
Accessibility: call out interactive text sizes for mobile vs desktop; ensure tappable area >= 44px
